5. Secondary DR Data Center & Tape Vault [Disaster Recovery Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The warm standby disaster recovery data center (located in Ikeja/Alausa with 25km geographic separation) hosting warm standby Finacle Core Banking, Oracle 19c Active Data Guard synchronous standby, DR Dell Data Domain appliance, and offsite physical Montgomery Vaults air-gapped tape archival.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Guarantees business continuity against catastrophic primary data center failure, power collapse, or metropolitan fiber cuts. Provides zero data loss (RPO = 0) and automated failover in under 5 minutes.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Primary DC Oracle RAC via Active Data Guard (Port 1521 over DCI Dark Fiber), Primary Data Domain via DD Boost Async (Port 2051) • OUTBOUND: Montgomery Vaults (Lagos) via weekly armored courier transport of LTO-8 tapes, Failover to Branch & Cloud routers upon DR activation • FAILOVER: Fast-Start Failover (FSFO) with independent cloud observer node (RPO=0, RTO<5 min); VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM) automated application restart. • SECURITY: Subterranean gas-suppressed climate-controlled vault storage, air-gapped from IP networks to eliminate ransomware vectors. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 5. SECONDARY DISASTER RECOVERY DC & TAPE VAULT
DR & ARCHIVE

g.title:
Oracle Database 19c Standby (Active Data Guard) [Section 5: Secondary DR DC] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Disaster recovery standby database running at the secondary data center (Ikeja/Alausa) receiving synchronous block-level redo logs.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Provides guaranteed zero data loss (RPO = 0) and automated failover in under 5 minutes (RTO < 5 min) via Fast-Start Failover (FSFO) if the primary data center experiences catastrophic loss.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Primary Oracle 19c RAC via Synchronous Redo Transport (Port 1521 over DCI Dark Fiber) • OUTBOUND: Promoted to Primary Read/Write Master upon Fast-Start Failover (FSFO) activation • FAILOVER: Fast-Start Failover (FSFO) with independent cloud observer node (RPO=0, RTO<5 min); snapshot standby mode for non-disruptive DR testing. • SECURITY: Oracle TDE encryption with replicated HSM keys, continuous block corruption detection, and strict biometric data center physical security. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Oracle Database 19c Standby (Active Data Guard - ADG)
Disaster Recovery Standby Database with Zero Data Loss:
• Synchronous Zero Data Loss Replication (RPO = 0) over dedicated dark fiber DCI link
• Fast-Start Failover (FSFO): Automated failover in < 5 minutes (RTO < 5 min)
• Observer node deployed in independent cloud availability zone to prevent split-brain
• Real-Time Redo Apply with continuous block corruption validation
• Can be opened in snapshot standby mode for automated disaster recovery drills
ACTIVE DATA GUARD
RPO = 0 | RTO < 5 MIN
Standby Core Banking & Applications (Dell VxRail DR HCI)
Warm Standby Computing Infrastructure at Secondary Facility:
• Cloned Dell VxRail HCI nodes pre-configured with Finacle 11.x binaries and OS images
• Standby Postilion Financial Switch with SQL Server AlwaysOn async replica
• VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM) automated one-click runbook orchestration
• Location: Tier III Facility (Ikeja / Alausa, Lagos - 25km geographical separation)
VMWARE SRM DR
Dell EMC Data Domain DR Appliance
Remote Secondary Backup Target:
• Asynchronous replication target for Primary Data Domain backup streams
• Deduplicated network replication optimizes bandwidth utilization
• Independent retention locks protect backup sets against ransomware encryption
• Protocol: DD Boost over dedicated encrypted WAN link (Port 2051)
DD BOOST REPLICATION

g.title:
Montgomery Vaults (Lagos) Air-Gapped Archival [Section 5: Secondary DR DC] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Subterranean, climate-controlled, gas-suppressed commercial vault facility storing encrypted Dell PowerVault LTO-8 magnetic tape cartridges.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: The bank's ultimate, unhackable disaster defense. Provides physical air-gapped isolation from all computer networks, guaranteeing 10-year immutable WORM record retention per Central Bank of Nigeria mandates.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Weekly physical armored courier transport of encrypted LTO-8 tapes from Primary/DR Data Centers • OUTBOUND: Physical retrieval and tape mount in disaster recovery or regulatory audit scenarios • FAILOVER: Multiple physical copies; subterranean seismic and fireproof construction. • SECURITY: Physical air-gap (100% disconnected from IP networks), hardware AES-256 tape encryption, dual-custody access controls, and WORM compliance. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Montgomery Vaults (Lagos) — Air-Gapped Cold Archival
Physical Offsite Immutable Archival (WORM Tape Retention):
• Dell PowerVault LTO-8 Tape Library: Automated weekly full backups written to physical tapes
• Air-Gapped Isolation: Completely disconnected from all IP networks to eliminate ransomware risk
• Armored Physical Transport: Escorted weekly courier transfer in fireproof, sealed pelican cases
• Vault Facility: Montgomery Vaults (Lagos) climate-controlled, gas-suppressed subterranean vault
• Retention Policy: 10-Year immutable WORM compliance per CBN financial record directives
AIR-GAPPED LTO-8 TAPE
10-YEAR CBN RETENTION
